analogy.rationale: Calpain is a calcium-dependent cysteine protease with no listed drug targets in this class, and the reference list contains no other calpain inhibitors; the closest mechanistic neighbors are calcium-signaling modulators and proteolytic-pathway drugs, but these act through distinct downstream programs, so the expected transcriptional response is weak.
